description: Defines the FilterSourceStream class, a specialized SourceStream that reads from an upstream source and applies filtering. It includes method declarations for reading, filtering data, and managing stream state.

classes.name: FilterSourceStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream that reads from an upstream SourceStream and applies filtering, with methods for reading data, filtering, and stream state management.

methods.name: FilterSourceStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream with a specific type and upstream SourceStream.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, implementing the SourceStream interface.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the stream.

methods.name: MayHaveMoreBytes
methods.description: Indicates if the stream may have more data.

methods.name: ParseEncodingType
methods.description: Parses an encoding type from a string.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Performs the main processing loop for reading and filtering.

methods.name: DoReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the upstream source.

methods.name: DoFilterData
methods.description: Filters data from input buffer to output buffer.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when IO operation completes.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to filter data, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of the stream.

methods.name: NeedMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if more input data is needed.
